title: Kafka Essentials
destination: Run Kafka locally in KRaft mode, build reliable Node.js producers and consumers, move data with Connect, enforce schemas, and operate and secure a cluster with confidence.

prerequisites.title: Install Docker.
prerequisites.note: Run docker --version to check it works.

prerequisites.title: Read and write basic Node.js.
prerequisites.note: Use async functions, promises, and npm packages.

nextSteps.title: Kafka Streams
nextSteps.note: Process and transform topics on the JVM.

nextSteps.title: Apache Flink
nextSteps.note: Run stateful stream processing at larger scale.
